title: Fig in the Sun
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 3 — Learning — Phase 2: new sounds l, ll, ss
note_for_grown_ups: Another Phase 2 book. All the words can be sounded out letter by letter — take your time and let your child do the blending.

pages.text: Fig sat on a big log.
pages.illustration: Fig the green striped caterpillar stretched along the top of a large mossy log, all his little legs in a neat row. Detailed bark texture.
The sun drawn large and hot at the top of the page, the log and Fig small below in a pool of hard light. Strong shadows.
Fig warmed to a deep sunset red by the heat, still stripy underneath, looking slightly alarmed at his own colour. Funny.

pages.text: Fig had a nap in the sun.
pages.illustration: Fig fast asleep on the log, curled into a comma shape, legs relaxed. Peaceful, warm, close-cropped.
Pip landing on the log with a bump, tail up, waking the whole log. Fig jolting awake mid-frame.
Pip nudging Fig with one wing while Fig grips the bark with all his legs, refusing to move. Comic tug of war.
Fig mid-tantrum, reared up, all legs waving, small and furious. Draw the fuss as bigger than the caterpillar.

pages.text: Pip and Fig sat in the sun.
pages.illustration: Closing page: the two of them side by side on the log in the low evening sun, calm again, long shadows behind them.
